sections.title: From clinical floors to your kitchen

slots.text: From clinical floors to your kitchen

I started my career on hospital wards, watching brilliant patients leave with diet sheets they could never realistically follow. It became obvious that good nutrition advice fails the moment it ignores someone's real life.

So I rebuilt the way I coach. Today every plan I write begins with your kitchen, your calendar and the foods you genuinely love — then layers in the science that quietly changes how you feel, sleep and perform.
A decade of clinical and 1:1 coaching experience, grounded in formal nutrition science and ongoing professional certification.
MSc Clinical Nutrition · BSc Dietetics. Registered Dietitian (RD), licensed and continually credentialed.
10+ years coaching 2,400+ clients across 32 countries — from hospital wards to a thriving private practice.
